errors.text_span: в диапазон от 0 до 160 000 млн. лв., с интервали от 20 000 млн. лв.
errors.evidence: The phrasing is redundant. The y-axis label is "Млн. лв." (Millions of BGN) and the axis values go up to 160,000. The description says "160 000 млн. лв.", which is like saying "160,000 millions of BGN". This repetition is confusing and verbose.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете за всяка година са групирани по категории
errors.evidence: This misrepresents the chart's structure. The bars are grouped by year (2014 and 2015), and within each year-group, there are bars for the different categories. The description incorrectly states that the bars are grouped by category.

errors.text_span: отразявайки сумата от двете предходни категории
errors.evidence: While the "Общо" (Total) bar does represent the sum of the other two bars, explicitly stating this relationship is an interpretation of the data, not a direct description of what is visually presented. The chart shows three separate values for each year; the additive relationship is an inference.
